title: calamagrostis × baltica
intro: Calamagrostis × baltica, commonly known as Baltic reed grass, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the grass family (Poaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Baltic reed grass include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in alleviating symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
